questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Light year is a unit used for measuring:
questions.explanation: A light year is the total distance that light travels in a vacuum in one Julian year (approx. 9.46 × 10¹⁵ meters). Thus, it is a unit of astronomical distance, not time.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 2: Units and Measurements

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The area under a velocity-time (v-t) graph gives:
questions.explanation: Integrating velocity over time (∫ v dt) yields displacement. Graphically, the area enclosed between the curve and the time axis equals the magnitude of total displacement.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 3: Motion in a Straight Line

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: How many atoms are present in exactly 1 mole of helium gas?
questions.explanation: One mole of any monoatomic element contains Avogadro's constant number of atoms, which is equal to 6.022 × 10²³ atoms.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 1: Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Which rule states that no two electrons in an atom can have the same set of four quantum numbers?
questions.explanation: Pauli's Exclusion Principle dictates that an orbital can hold a maximum of two electrons, and they must have opposite spins, meaning no two electrons can share identical quantum numbers.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 2: Structure of Atom

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Which non-membrane bound organelle is present in both prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells?
questions.explanation: Ribosomes are non-membrane bound organelles found in both prokaryotes (70S) and eukaryotes (80S), essential for protein synthesis.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 8: Cell: The Unit of Life

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: The primary structural component of plant cell walls is:
questions.explanation: Plant cell walls are primarily made of cellulose (a complex polysaccharide of glucose units), whereas fungal walls contain chitin and bacterial walls contain peptidoglycan.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 8: Cell: The Unit of Life

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Which of the following organisms exhibits radial symmetry?
questions.explanation: Adult echinoderms (e.g., starfishes) display radial symmetry, whereas their larvae display bilateral symmetry. Annelids, arthropods, and flatworms show bilateral symmetry throughout.

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Flame cells are specialized excretory structures found in:
questions.explanation: Flame cells (protonephridia) are specialized excretory and osmoregulatory organs characteristic of flatworms (Phylum Platyhelminthes, e.g., Planaria, Tapeworm).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Which of the following pairs has identical physical dimensions?
questions.explanation: Impulse = Force × time = [MLT⁻²][T] = [MLT⁻¹]. Momentum = mass × velocity = [M][LT⁻¹] = [MLT⁻¹]. Thus, both Impulse and Momentum have the same dimensional formula.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 2: Units and Measurements

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Molarity (M) of a solution is defined as the number of moles of solute dissolved in:
questions.explanation: Molarity (M) = (Moles of solute) / (Volume of solution in Litres). Molality (m), on the other hand, is defined per kilogram of solvent.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 1: Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry
